name: voltessa-onnx-inference-service
description: Standalone Node process that runs onnxruntime-node's native binary on the Scaleway VM, where it works reliably, instead of Vercel's serverless runtime, where it does not (libonnxruntime.so.1 fails to load there - confirmed in production after two standard Next.js fixes both failed). Voltessa (apps/web) sends already-built feature matrices plus ONNX model bytes over authenticated HTTP and receives back raw numeric predictions; this service holds zero business logic (no plants, no weather, no DB) - purely numeric compute, mirroring automation/'s own narrow-purpose pattern. Independent process, not part of the pnpm workspace.
